description: Plans a meetup with one accepted friend or suggests an outdoor place from city/current/home location. Use it when the user wants to go out with a friend or needs a location-aware outdoor recommendation.

tools.name: propose_friend_meetup
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to go out with exactly one accepted friend. Pass friend_name when it can be extracted from the prompt.

tools.name: suggest_outdoor_place
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an outdoor place recommendation for a city or their current area. The backend resolves explicit city mentions first, then device location, then saved home coordinates.
